profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Fabletics
profile.summary:
As a Senior Mobile Software Engineer at Fabletics, I lead development initiatives across our iOS and Android applications. My focus is on building resilient mobile architectures and streamlining developer workflows so our team can ship high-quality features efficiently.
​With a strong foundation in React Native, TypeScript, and global state management (Zustand), I recently helped drive our V2 mobile architecture migration and implemented automated CI/CD deployment pipelines from the ground up.

​Beyond the codebase, I value a highly collaborative engineering culture. I actively mentor junior engineers, conduct architectural reviews, and work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the software we build translates directly into a seamless user experience.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modernized the core React Native mobile application, driving large-scale code refactoring, UI upgrades, and image aspect ratio optimizations for a high-volume retail user base.

Designed and implemented automated deployment pipelines from the ground up. Replaced manual deployment processes with streamlined CI/CD workflows, eliminating release friction and reducing developer overhead.

Re-architected global state handling using Zustand and TypeScript. Replaced inefficient async state actions and custom hooks with optimized selectors to drastically improve app performance and eliminate memory leaks.

Translate complex business requirements and user stories into scalable technical architectures, ensuring stable and seamless experiences across both iOS and Android platforms.

Guide junior engineers through architectural reviews, technical roadmapping, and code quality standards, actively elevating the team's overall engineering execution.
positions.insights: Skills: Git · JavaScript · React native · Mobile Application Development · TypeScript · Software Design · Time Management

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Engineered and maintained internal mobile applications used daily by club associates to execute core retail operations, inventory management, and on-the-floor workflows.

Built and optimized mobile features designed to reduce friction in employee workflows, directly increasing operational speed and task efficiency across the retail network.

Partnered with product managers and operational stakeholders to translate complex internal retail requirements into stable, production-ready code deployed at Fortune 1 scale.

positions.title: Co-Founder & Lead Engineer
positions.description:
Architected and engineered a social music listening mobile application from the ground up using React Native and JavaScript, featuring complex data integrations with Spotify APIs.

Built and guided the founding engineering team. Managed technical recruiting, established codebase standards, and enforced quality through rigorous design, code, and test case reviews.

Owned the technical roadmap and sprint cycles. Drove project estimation, prioritization, and cost-benefit analysis to ensure engineering output aligned with early-stage business goals and runway.

Designed workflow visualization systems that allowed management to identify operational bottlenecks and drastically improve cross-functional process efficiency.

positions.title: Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
Translated static design mock-ups into fully responsive, dynamic websites, ensuring high-fidelity cross-browser and mobile compatibility.

Built and customized CMS infrastructures utilizing WordPress and NationBuilder, engineering modular templates that empowered non-technical clients to autonomously manage and update their digital content.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Designed, engineered, and deployed a custom, client-facing website focused on increasing digital presence and driving initial user engagement.

Built automated workflows for first-time customer interactions, eliminating manual outreach and streamlining the client acquisition process.
